connected.description: Whether the remote cluster is connected to the local (querying) cluster.

skip_unavailable.description: The `skip_unavailable` setting for a remote cluster.

matching_indices.description:
Whether the index expression provided in the request matches any indices, aliases or data streams
on the cluster.

error.description:
Provides error messages that are likely to occur if you do a search with this index expression
on the specified cluster (for example, lack of security privileges to query an index).

version.description: Provides version information about the cluster.

indices.resolve_cluster__ResolveClusterI.description: Provides information about each cluster request relevant to doing a cross-cluster search.
